title: ward tree — standing
description: one of the three ancient ward trees of the unburning forest: a broad gnarled oak-like tree with a thick mossy trunk, roots gripping the ground, a full green crown with faint gold light between the leaves

title: ward tree — wounded
description: the SAME tree, same size and position, with deep fresh axe cuts in the trunk, pale wood showing, leaves falling, the gold light dimmer

title: ward tree — felled
description: the SAME tree cut down: a broad stump with a raw pale cut face and roots in place, the fallen trunk lying behind it to the right, no light

title: guardian statue — sleeping
description: the guardian statue (match your sprite_guardianStatue.png if you have painted it, otherwise a stone knight with a tower shield and a longsword) standing still on a square stone plinth, eyes dark, weathered grey granite with moss, no light
